ruleset.name: nitpicker-spring
ruleset.description: Nitpicker Spring rules: one allowed way for dependency injection, proxies, web, JPA and Spring Data.

rule.name: SpringConstructorInjection
rule.message: Inject through the constructor into private final fields. Do not put @Autowired, @Inject, @Resource or @Value on fields or setters.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //FieldDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation | //MethodDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation )[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.inject.Inject') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.annotation.Resource') or (pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value') and (parent::ModifierList/parent::FieldDeclaration or parent::ModifierList/parent::MethodDeclaration[not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean')])]))] | //ConstructorDeclaration[count(../ConstructorDeclaration) = 1]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.inject.Inject')]

rule.name: SpringImmutableBeans
rule.message: Make this bean field final. Beans are shared singletons, so keep per-call state in locals.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static') and not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.PersistenceUnit')])]

rule.name: SpringNoServiceLocator
rule.message: Inject the bean you need through the constructor instead of looking it up in the ApplicationContext or BeanFactory. Use ObjectProvider for optional or prototype beans.

rule.name: SpringNoLazyInjection
rule.message: Remove @Lazy from this injection point. It hides a dependency cycle; break the cycle with a new component or an event instead.

rule.name: SpringLiteConfiguration
rule.message: Write @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false) and take dependencies as @Bean method parameters instead of calling other @Bean methods.

rule.name: SpringNoComponentScan
rule.message: Put the @SpringBootApplication class in the top package and let it scan its own packages; do not add @ComponentScan or scanBasePackages.

rule.name: SpringTypedConfiguration
rule.message: Read configuration through a @ConfigurationProperties record, not @Value, System.getenv, System.getProperty or Environment.getProperty.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FormalParameter/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value')] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration')])] | //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController')]] //MethodCall[ (@MethodName = ('getenv', 'getProperty') and *[1][self::TypeExpression and pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System')] and not(ArgumentList/StringLiteral[1][matches(@ConstValue, '^(java|user|os|file|line|path)\.')])) or (@MethodName = ('getProperty', 'getRequiredProperty') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.core.env.PropertyResolver')])]

rule.name: SpringProfileOnConfiguration
rule.message: Put @Profile only on a @Configuration class or a @Bean method, so profiles choose beans and never branch business code.

rule.name: SpringProxyMethodVisibility
rule.message: Make this proxied method public, non-final and non-static, in a non-final class. Spring never proxies final or static methods, and nitpicker keeps proxied methods public.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.CachePut') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.Caching') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.retry.annotation.Retryable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.resilience.annotation.Retryable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PostAuthorize') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.security.access.annotation.Secured')] [ parent::ModifierList/parent::MethodDeclaration[ not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1][@Interface = true()])] [@Visibility != 'public' or pmd-java:modifiers() = ('final', 'static')] or parent::ModifierList/parent::ClassDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final'] ]

rule.name: SpringProxySelfCall
rule.message: This call stays inside the class, so it skips the proxy and the called method''s annotation does nothing. Move the annotated method to another bean and call it there.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::TypeArguments or self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]][ let $name := @MethodName, $arity := count(ArgumentList/*), $callerTransactional := exists(ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')]) return exists(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $name][@Arity = $arity] /ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.CachePut') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.cache.annotation.Caching') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.retry.annotation.Retryable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.resilience.annotation.Retryable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PostAuthorize') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.security.access.annotation.Secured')] [not($callerTransactional and not(AnnotationMemberList) and pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional'))]) ]

rule.name: SpringTransactionalAnnotation
rule.message: Use org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional. The jakarta and javax annotations have no readOnly or timeout and roll back on different exceptions.

rule.name: SpringNoTransactionalController
rule.message: Put @Transactional on a service method, not on a controller; a controller transaction spans the whole request and response serialization.

rule.name: SpringNoRequiresNew
rule.message: Avoid Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW: each nested transaction holds a second connection and can exhaust the pool under load.

rule.name: SpringNoSwallowedTransactionException
rule.message: Do not swallow a broad or persistence exception inside a @Transactional method: the transaction may already be rollback-only, so the commit fails anyway. Rethrow it, or catch it in the caller.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] or (@Visibility = 'public' and ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')])] //CatchClause[not(.//ThrowStatement)][not(ancestor::LambdaExpression or ancestor::ClassBody[parent::ConstructorCall])] [CatchParameter//ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Exception') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.RuntimeException') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Throwable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.TransactionException') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException')]]

rule.name: SpringAsyncExecutor
rule.message: Name a bounded executor bean, @Async("executorName"), and return CompletableFuture so failures reach the caller.

rule.name: SpringScheduledFixedDelay
rule.message: Use fixedDelay or cron instead of fixedRate, so a slow run never overlaps the next one.

rule.name: SpringComposedMapping
rule.message: Use @GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @PatchMapping or @DeleteMapping on methods. @RequestMapping belongs only on the class, for the path prefix.

rule.name: SpringRestController
rule.message: Use @RestController for a JSON controller and drop @ResponseBody.

rule.name: SpringValidRequestBody
rule.message: Add @Valid to this @RequestBody; without it the record''s constraints are never checked.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FormalParameter[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody')]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.validation.Valid') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated')])] [not(ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.CharSequence') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Number') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Boolean') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.InputStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.core.io.Resource') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode') or pmd-java:typeIs('tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode')])] [not(ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Optional')] /TypeArguments/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.CharSequence') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Number') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Boolean')])] [not(ArrayType or PrimitiveType)]

rule.name: SpringNoCrossOrigin
rule.message: Configure CORS once, in a CorsConfigurationSource bean with origins from configuration, instead of @CrossOrigin on controllers.

rule.name: SpringPasswordEncoder
rule.message: Hash passwords with PasswordEncoderFactories.createDelegatingPasswordEncoder(); NoOpPasswordEncoder stores them in plain text.

rule.name: JpaLazyFetching
rule.message: Write fetch = FetchType.LAZY on every @ManyToOne and @OneToOne (they are eager by default) and never use EAGER; load what a query needs with join fetch.

rule.name: JpaEntityClass
rule.message: Make the entity a non-final class. Records and final classes cannot be JPA entities; use records for DTOs.

rule.name: JpaManyToManyCascade
rule.message: Do not cascade ALL or REMOVE on @ManyToMany: removing one parent deletes rows that other parents still share.

rule.name: JpaManyToManySet
rule.message: Map @ManyToMany as a Set (or a List with @OrderColumn). A plain List makes Hibernate delete and re-insert every join row when one element is removed.

rule.name: JpaVersion
rule.message: Add a @Version field next to the @Id, so concurrent updates fail instead of overwriting each other. Mark entities that are never updated with @Immutable.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass')]] [(not(ExtendsList) and ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity')]) or ClassBody/(FieldDeclaration | MethodDeclaration)/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Id') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EmbeddedId')]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.hibernate.annotations.Immutable')])] [not(ClassBody/(FieldDeclaration | MethodDeclaration)/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Version')])] /ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass')]

rule.name: JpaSequenceIds
rule.message: Generate ids with GenerationType.SEQUENCE (or UUID). IDENTITY and TABLE ids disable JDBC insert batching.

rule.name: SpringDataDerivedQuery
rule.message: Write this repository method with @Query (JPQL in a text block for JPA), naming the entity and every condition, instead of a query derived from the method name.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[@Interface = true()][ExtendsList/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository')]] /ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[not(Block) and not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('default', 'static'))] [not(@Name = ('findById', 'findAll', 'findAllById', 'findOne', 'findBy', 'count', 'exists', 'existsById', 'save', 'saveAll', 'saveAndFlush', 'saveAllAndFlush', 'delete', 'deleteById', 'deleteAll', 'deleteAllById', 'deleteAllInBatch', 'deleteAllByIdInBatch', 'getReferenceById'))] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.NativeQuery') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query.Procedure') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Procedure') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jdbc.repository.query.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.r2dbc.repository.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.Aggregation') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.neo4j.repository.query.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.cassandra.repository.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.couchbase.repository.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.Query')])]

rule.name: SpringDataNativeQuery
rule.message: Write the query in JPQL; native SQL is not checked at startup. If this one needs SQL, mark this method with @SuppressWarnings("PMD.SpringDataNativeQuery"), the only inline suppression nitpicker accepts.

rule.name: SpringDataModifyingQuery
rule.message: Write @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true, flushAutomatically = true), so pending changes are flushed first and no stale entities stay in the persistence context.

rule.name: SpringDataNoSaveInLoop
rule.message: Do not save or delete one entity per loop iteration. Collect the entities and call saveAll or deleteAll once.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('save', 'saveAndFlush', 'delete', 'deleteById', 'persist', 'merge', 'remove')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager')]] [ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement] [not(.//IfStatement[*[1]//InfixExpression[@Operator = '%']]//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear'][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager')]])] or ancestor::LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'map', 'peek', 'forEachOrdered')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]]]] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'map', 'peek', 'forEachOrdered')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]]/ArgumentList /MethodReference[@MethodName = ('save', 'saveAndFlush', 'delete', 'deleteById', 'persist', 'merge', 'remove')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager')]]

rule.name: SpringDataNoFlush
rule.message: Do not flush by hand. Let the transaction write changes at commit; an early flush defeats JDBC batching and hides ordering bugs.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('saveAndFlush', 'saveAllAndFlush', 'flush')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager')]] [not(ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement][1] [.//IfStatement[*[1]//InfixExpression[@Operator = '%']]//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear'][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager')]]])]

rule.name: SpringDataNamedParameters
rule.message: Bind query parameters by name (:email), not by position (?1); positions break silently when parameters are reordered.

rule.name: SpringDataQueryTextBlock
rule.message: Write a multi-part query as one text block (""") instead of joining strings with +.
